content:
The only objective way to determine overall investment is also too much work to be feasible: add all copies of limited awakeners used (E0 = 1 etc), their investment is the total number. It's not perfect of course, since some arc 1 awakeners are worth way less than arc 2 ones for example, and since breakpoints matter very much.
Obviously doesn't take into account SF/Skill levels/account lvl/awakener lvl/gear, but I think we can assume those track pretty closely.
so probably the practical way to do it is just glance value vibes

Example from my runs last season (blue ring). I'd consider this low investment.
A5 double clear waves, limited awakener copies used (e0 = 1):
wave 1: 8
wave 2: 10
wave 3: 13
wave 4: 28 (16 of which is the whale support borrow)
14 limited awakeners used total (incl. the Support), avg 1.75 per wave,
59 limited copies total, avg. 7.38 limited copies per wave.

wave 5 is double clear a4, so left it out. Since it's neither 400 nor 425 it's kinda hard to categorize this.
